title: PowerPoint

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Match presentation density to how people encounter it so an oral talk and a distributed document remain understandable.
strategic_value: Rhythm and a limited set of templates can make Helsinki presentations coherent without making every slide identical.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: bullets distinguish spoken, distributed and Teams presentations above a grid of slide examples.
practical_value: Use fewer layouts and visual pauses for a talk; use publication-like hierarchy for a deck sent to readers.

content_islands.name: Presentation advice
content_islands.spec: The upper list links templates and explains rhythm, density and delivery contexts.

content_islands.name: Slide examples
content_islands.spec: A contact sheet below combines image, quote, diagram and text layouts.

reference_purposes.Application: The source contrasts oral presentations with distributed publications and recommends a limited set of templates with visual pauses.

ingredient.name: Presentation rhythm
ingredient.role: Keep attention aligned with spoken or distributed content.
ingredient.application: Use a limited selection of slide templates and alternate dense content with images or pull quotes; design a distributed deck with publication-like hierarchy.
ingredient.scope: Advice for Helsinki PowerPoint presentations in the captured live guideline; delivery context changes the composition.
